name: 4d-blog-engine
description: 4D Blog Engine — operationalizes the 4D AI Fluency Framework (Delegation, Description, Discernment, Diligence) for content production. v0.5.7 closes the media-file gap end-to-end: (1) /blog-init creates Posts/, drafts/, and drafts/blog-media/ at setup. (2) /blog-start scans the session's uploads/ folder; if the writer dragged a markdown file plus media files into Cowork chat, it offers 'Start a new post from your uploads' as the top option, copies media to drafts/blog-media/, and kicks off /blog automatically. (3) The /blog orchestrator's Phase 2 (Description) scans drafts/blog-media/ before the voice interview and asks the writer for a one-line caption per new file; captions persist to state.md's `media:` array, which the Phase 3 content-writer reads to emit the YAML media: block in the signed blog.md. (4) /publish parses the YAML media: array, verifies each file exists in drafts/blog-media/ (pre-flight halts if missing), copies them to the publishing repo's public/blog-media/<basename>, creates the destination folder if absent, and includes them all in one commit alongside the post and hero. The writer drops files into chat, types captions when asked, says 'go' once, clicks Push origin in GitHub Desktop — the plugin handles every other step including the previously-improvised media handling that lost the dogfood post's xlsx attachment. No PAT, no API token, no MCP-server auth config; GitHub Desktop's existing auth handles the push. Silent .git/index.lock recovery if GitHub Desktop's file-watcher races the commit. Byte-identical republishes silently bump dateModified so the rebuild fires once pushed. v0.5.2 introduced the local drafts/ convention: Phase 4 sign-off copies the signed post to <blog-project-dir>/drafts/<slug>.md as a clean writer-facing handoff; /publish reads from there. The piece directory at Posts/<slug>/ remains the forensic archive. v0.5.0 rewrote /publish end-to-end with vendored smart_quotes.py, hardened the earned-secret stall with deterministic checks, and reoriented hero-image proposals to story-grounded options first. v0.4.0 added /blog-voice (multi-voice supported) and unhardcoded all preset-voice references. v0.3.x stripped backend infrastructure out of the writer-facing setup. v0.2.0 added the lifecycle commands. Pipeline: takes a base document and an angle question; runs a 30-day discourse sweep across reddit, X, Hacker News, Substack, Facebook, Quora, podcasts, and academic sources; layers a /council:deliberate synthesis pass; builds a verified bibliography with AI-generated abstracts; drafts the blog post in the writer's voice using the research-pipeline content-writer; runs a two-tier anti-AI-slop pass (deterministic linter + LLM structural review with a second-pass audit); and ships through a nonce-bound Release Owner Gate scoring against a 100-point rubric. On a clean gate, produces a publication-ready blog post, a long-form LinkedIn article (full mirror, blog stays canonical), and a short hook-led LinkedIn teaser with a 3-axis scorecard. Trigger phrases: 'write a blog post from this document', 'derive a blog from this whitepaper', '/4d-blog-engine', 'set up the blog plugin', 'publish this post', 'release-owner gate'. Implements the Release Owner Gate from MoxyWolf's 'Beyond the Prompt' whitepaper.
